test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In Pradhan Mantri Gramin Awaas Yojana, the cost of unit assistance is shared between Central and State Governments in the ratio ________ for the North-Eastern and the Himalayan states.
solution:
The correct answer is __**90 : 10**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Pradhan Mantri Gramin Awaas Yojana (PMGAY) is a social welfare flagship program created by the Indian Government to provide housing for the rural poor.

• For the North-Eastern and the Himalayan states, the cost sharing ratio between the Central and State Governments is 90:10.

• This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the homeless and those living in kutcha houses to construct pucca houses.

• It ensures that people living in difficult areas such as hilly terrains and remote regions also have access to housing support.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Pradhan Mantri Gramin Awaas Yojana (PMGAY)**

• Formerly known as Indira Awaas Yojana, it was revamped in 2016 as Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G).

• It aims to provide financial assistance for constructing pucca houses with basic amenities to homeless families and those living in dilapidated houses.

• The cost of unit assistance is shared between the Central and State Governments for various states in different ratios.

• In plain areas, the cost sharing ratio is 60:40 between Central and State Governments.

• For the North-Eastern and the Himalayan states, the cost sharing ratio is 90:10 between the Central and State Governments.

• For Union Territories, the entire cost is borne by the Central Government.

• **Other Similar Schemes:**

• **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)**

• This scheme is aimed at addressing the urban housing shortage among the Economically Weaker Section (EWS)/Low Income Group (LIG) and Middle Income Group (MIG) categories including the slum dwellers by ensuring a pucca house to all eligible urban households by the year 2022.

• The scheme is implemented through four verticals: In-situ Slum Redevelopment, Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme, Affordable Housing in Partnership, and Subsidy for beneficiary-led individual house construction/enhancement.

• **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana**

• This is a financial inclusion program aimed at ensuring affordable access to financial services such as bank accounts, remittances, credit, insurance, and pensions.

• Launched on 28 August 2014, it aims to provide universal access to banking facilities with at least one basic banking account for every household.
